info.title: IoT Connectivity Management Platform API
info.description: Core API for managing IoT SIM lifecycles, billing, and real-time connectivity diagnostics. Designed for MNOs, MVNOs, and Enterprise customers.

tags.name: SIMs
tags.description: SIM search, details, plans, and subscriptions

tags.name: Inbound Webhooks

tags.name: Packages
tags.description: **Sellable `packages` rows** (`package_id` / `packageId`) managed by **status** (`DRAFT` / `PUBLISHED` / `DEPRECATED`) and id — no separate version dimension.

tags.name: Rating Fallback Packages
tags.description: Default Fallback Package mappings for no-active-subscription usage rating. These endpoints map a reseller + supplier + operator to an ordinary published package; they do not create subscriptions or special package types.

tags.name: NetworkProfiles
tags.description:
**APN** and **Roaming** profile management (snapshots, publish/deprecate).
**Out-of-profile (OOP)** rates use **Carrier Service `roamingProfileId`** only — **not** a field on **PricePlan**.
For **in-profile** (MCC,MNC) allowlists reused by **Price Plans**, see tag **CoveredNetworkProfiles**.

tags.name: CoveredNetworkProfiles
tags.description:
**CoveredNetworkProfile** — reusable **in-profile** (MCC,MNC) coverage snapshots (**DRAFT / PUBLISHED / DEPRECATED**), referenced by **all** **Price Plan** types via **`coveredNetworkProfileId`** (**ONE_TIME**, **SIM_DEPENDENT_BUNDLE**, **FIXED_BUNDLE**, **TIERED_PRICING**).
Distinct from **RoamingProfile**: **OOP** routing is **Package → Carrier Service → roamingProfileId** only.

tags.name: Resellers
tags.description: Reseller management. Path segment **`{resellerId}`** on `/resellers/{resellerId}` and nested routes is the RESELLER **`tenants.tenant_id`** (**FR-058**, same value as JWT `resellerId`); query/body field **`resellerId`** keeps that meaning on list/filter APIs. Responses may include **`resellerRecordId`** (`resellers.id`).

Error.description:
Unified error envelope for API responses.
- `code` uses stable machine-readable values (for example: `BAD_REQUEST`, `UNAUTHORIZED`, `FORBIDDEN`, `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, `NOT_FOUND`, `INVALID_STATUS`, `REFERENCES_BLOCKED`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`).
- `message` uses field-level validation wording: `"<field> is required."` or `"<field> is invalid."` for request validation failures.
- `traceId` is returned when available and should be used for troubleshooting.

currentValue.description: Current measured value for the alert. For `CDR_DELAY`, this is the number of delayed CDR files for the reseller. For `UPSTREAM_DISCONNECT`, this is the consecutive failed token probe count.

metadata.description: Alert-specific details. For `CDR_DELAY`, metadata may include `delayedFiles`, `cdrFileIds`, `affectedIccidCount`, `sampleIccids`, `supplierIds`, `operatorIds`, and `thresholdUnit`. For `UPSTREAM_DISCONNECT`, metadata may include `integrationId`, `supplierId`, `operatorId`, `probeApi`, `failureCount`, `lastSuccessAt`, `lastFailureAt`, `lastErrorCode`, `lastErrorMessage`, and `thresholdUnit`.

groupBy.description: When null/omitted on request, response groupBy is null and items are total-only (`period` + `totalMb`). When set, items include `groupKey` / `groupLabel`.

groupKey.description: enterpriseId (UUID) or MCC (3 digits) when groupBy is set.

groupLabel.description: Enterprise name when groupBy=enterprise; MCC echo when groupBy=mcc.

total.description: Total SIMs in scope (includes reseller inventory when scoped by reseller).

byEnterprise.description: SIM counts by assigned enterprise. Populated for reseller-wide / platform-wide scope; empty when a single enterpriseId is selected (or customer token).

enterpriseId.description: Null for inventory SIMs not assigned to an enterprise.

byVisitedMcc.description: Distinct SIM counts by **visited network MCC** (country of use), derived from `usage_daily_summary.visited_mccmnc` (first 3 digits). Not the SIM home/operator MCC.

count.description: Distinct SIMs with usage in this visited MCC within visitedMccWindow.

visitedMccWindow.description: Date window applied to byVisitedMcc (default last 6 calendar months).

resellerId.description: JWT claim — RESELLER **`tenants.tenant_id`** when `roleScope` is `reseller` (**FR-058**).

message.description: Generic message (does not reveal whether the email is registered).

devResetUrl.description:
Present only in non-production when mail is logged locally (no SMTP).
Contains the one-time reset link for developer testing. Never rely on this in production.

token.description: One-time token from the password-reset email link.

defaultThresholdValue.description: Default threshold for the alert type. For `SILENT_SIM`, this is deactivated duration in hours; the catalog default is `4320` (about 180 days / 6 months).

defaultThresholdUnit.description: Unit for `defaultThresholdValue`; `SILENT_SIM` uses `HOURS` for long-running `DEACTIVATED` SIM detection.

items.description: Full set of alert config items allowed for this profile scope.
Full set of alert config items for the requested scope. Enterprise profiles must not include reseller-level alert types such as CDR_DELAY, UPSTREAM_DISCONNECT, or WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_FAILED.

resellerId.description: RESELLER tenants.tenant_id (FR-058)

RESELLER **`tenants.tenant_id`** (`tenant_type=RESELLER`). Blank/omitted is treated as not provided.
- **reseller token**: optional; defaults to token `resellerId`; if provided must exist and match token scope.
- **customer token**: optional; if omitted, inferred from the enterprise parent; if provided must match.
- **platform/admin**: **required**; must exist.

enterpriseId.description:
ENTERPRISE **`tenants.tenant_id`**. Blank/omitted is treated as not provided.
- **reseller token**: **required**; must exist and belong to the effective resellerId.
- **customer token**: optional; defaults to token enterprise; if provided must match token.
- **platform/admin**: **required**; must exist and belong to resellerId.
Reseller-level subscriptions (null enterpriseId) are not creatable via this API.

enabled.description:

Cannot set DEPRECATED via PATCH — use `POST .../{webhookId}:deprecate`.

resellerId.description: Optional scope. Reseller callers may omit (forced to token reseller) or must equal token resellerId. Platform may omit (global), or pass an existing RESELLER tenant id.

enterpriseId.description: Optional. When set, must be an existing ENTERPRISE under the effective reseller. Wrong id → 404; out of reseller → 403. When omitted with a resellerId, rolls up all child enterprises.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Omit / null / blank → no idempotency; each call creates a new job. If the same non-empty key was already used for USAGE_RATING_ROLLUP → **409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT**.

period.description: Calendar month to roll up (YYYY-MM). Defaults to previous UTC calendar month. Must not be a future month. Current month is allowed (partial snapshot; later rollups overwrite). Execution fails with 404 if no `usage_daily_summary` rows exist for the period/scope. Aggregates usage_daily_summary → usage_monthly_summary. Independent of billing generate.

resellerId.description: Optional scope. Reseller callers may omit (forced to token reseller) or must equal token resellerId. Platform may omit (global), or pass an existing RESELLER tenant id.

enterpriseId.description: Optional. When set, must be an existing ENTERPRISE under the effective reseller (reseller token reseller, or platform-provided resellerId). Wrong id → 404; out of reseller → 403. When set alone by platform, scopes to that enterprise. When omitted with a resellerId, rolls up all child enterprises under that reseller.

resellerId.description: When present, RESELLER **`tenants.tenant_id`** or related scope id for SIM tenancy (**FR-058**).

EnterpriseSimListItem.description: Enterprise-visible SIM row (no supplier/operator/reseller catalog identifiers).

enterpriseId.description: Target ENTERPRISE tenant. Must exist, belong to the caller reseller when caller is reseller scoped, and be SUSPENDED.

batchId.description: Optional idempotency key (same as **POST /sims/import-jobs**). When set, a second request with the same **batchId** returns **409 DUPLICATE_BATCH** after the first completes successfully. When omitted, the SHA-256 of the uploaded **file** body is used as the idempotency key.

file.description: CSV file. Required column **iccid** only (optional **imsi** for human reference; not used for assignment). At most 100 data rows.

simId.description: SIM row primary key (internal); use **iccid** as the business identifier.

skipped.description: True when **enterprise_id** was already set on the SIM; no row update is performed. Includes same-target (no-op) and other-enterprise cases (过户 / transfer not implemented — skipped, not failed).

currentEnterpriseId.description: Present when **skipped** is true — the enterprise the SIM is already assigned to.

targetEnterpriseId.description: Present when **skipped** is true — the **enterpriseId** from the request.

transferNotSupported.description: True when **skipped** and **currentEnterpriseId** differs from **targetEnterpriseId** (re-assign not supported).

total.description: Number of ICCIDs submitted in the file (one result row per input ICCID).

succeeded.description: SIMs updated in this request (had no **enterprise_id** and passed validation).

failed.description: SIMs that could not be assigned (invalid id, not found, wrong state, wrong reseller, etc.).

skipped.description: SIMs that already had **enterprise_id** set; not written again. Same-enterprise and other-enterprise (过户) are both counted here — **failed** is not incremented for skipped rows.

enterpriseId.description: Enterprise **tenants.tenant_id**. **Required** for **reseller_admin** and **platform_admin** (must be in reseller scope for reseller tokens). Optional for **customer_admin** (defaults to JWT enterprise); when provided, must match the authenticated enterprise.

departmentId.description: Child department under the enterprise; must exist and belong to **enterpriseId**.

batchId.description: Optional idempotency key (same as **POST /sims/import-jobs** and **POST /sims:assign-inventory-to-enterprise**). Duplicate **batchId** after a successful run returns **409 DUPLICATE_BATCH**. When omitted, SHA-256 of **file** is used.

file.description: CSV with required column **iccid** only (optional **imsi** ignored). At most 100 data rows.

skipped.description: True when **department_id** already equals **departmentId**; no row update.

succeeded.description: SIMs whose **department_id** was updated in this request.

failed.description: ICCIDs not found, invalid format, or SIM not assigned to this enterprise.

skipped.description: SIMs already on the target department (no update).

SimBatchLifecycleAction.description: Same lifecycle actions as single-SIM endpoints (`:activate`, `:deactivate`, `:reactivate`, `:retire`, `:mark-test-ready`). **Mark-test-ready** is synchronous in CMP (no `SIM_STATUS_CHANGE` job). **Retire** and **Mark-test-ready** require **reseller admin** or **platform admin** (forbidden for customer / department tokens).

SimBatchStatusChangeRequest.description: JSON body for manual ICCID selection (**ICCID List**). Provide **iccids** (1–100 items). Do not send **file** here; use **multipart/form-data** for CSV upload (**ICCID CSV File**).

confirm.description: **Retire only** — same as **POST /sims/{iccid}:retire** (`SimRetireRequest`). Required **true** when **action** is **Retire**; omit or ignore for Activate / Deactivate / Reactivate / Mark-test-ready.

commitmentExempt.description: **Retire only** — same as **POST /sims/{iccid}:retire**. When **true**, skips commitment-period check per ICCID; ignored for other **action** values. Reseller/platform admin only (see single-card retire).

batchId.description: Optional batch idempotency key. Duplicate **batchId** + **action** after success → **409 DUPLICATE_BATCH**.

SimBatchStatusChangeForm.description: Multipart form for batch lifecycle. ICCID source is **mutually exclusive**: fill **iccids** (**ICCID List**) **or** upload **file** (**ICCID CSV File**), not both. Programmatic clients may alternatively POST `application/json` with `{ "action", "iccids": ["…"] }` (same fields as below where applicable).

iccids.description: **ICCID List** — comma-separated ICCIDs or JSON array string, e.g. `8986012345678901234,8986012345678901235` or `["8986012345678901234"]`. Max 100. Leave empty when using **file**.

file.description: **ICCID CSV File** — CSV with header row and single column **iccid** (one ICCID per data row, max 100 rows). No other columns required. Leave empty when using **iccids**.

reason.description: Required when **action** is **Deactivate**, **Retire**, or **Mark-test-ready**; optional for Activate / Reactivate.

confirm.description: **Retire only** — must be **true** when **action** is **Retire** (same as **POST /sims/{iccid}:retire**). Leave empty for other actions.

commitmentExempt.description: **Retire only** — optional; skips commitment check when **true**. Same semantics as single-card retire; ignored unless **action** is **Retire**.

batchId.description: Optional batch idempotency key (same as assign-inventory / import-jobs). When set, a second request with the same **batchId** and **action** after the first completes returns **409 DUPLICATE_BATCH**. When omitted on CSV upload, the SHA-256 of the **file** body is used instead.

jobId.description: Per-SIM SIM_STATUS_CHANGE job when accepted (ok=true, non-idempotent).

targetStatus.description: Intended steady state after upstream confirms.

lifecycleSubStatus.description: Pending sub-status (*ing) while job is in flight.

afterStatus.description: Use targetStatus; kept for backward compatibility.

eventKey.description: Inbound event key from CMP catalog (`GET /v1/upstream-webhook-events`), e.g. `subscription`, `update-location`, `sim-status-changed`, `traffic-alert`.

enabled.description: Whether this integration accepts inbound webhook callbacks for this eventKey.

resellerId.description: RESELLER `tenants.tenant_id`; upstream connectivity alerts are scoped to this reseller.

operatorId.description: Business operator dictionary id when available; otherwise operators row PK.

authType.description: Effective outbound auth mode (derived). Priority: apiKey+apiSecret, else username+password. Optional on create; when sent it must match the effective mode.

resellerId.description: RESELLER `tenants.tenant_id` owning this supplier/operator integration.

adapterType.description: CMP adapter implementation id. It is defined by CMP (adapter registry), not by each supplier/operator record. For current V1.1 supported upstream, use `wxzhonggeng`.

name.description: Required display name; null or empty string is rejected.

apiEndpoint.description: Required http/https URL; null, empty, or invalid URL is rejected.

apiKey.description: Outbound API key (pair with **apiSecret**; JSON camelCase, not `api_key`). May be stored together with username/password; runtime uses api_key first when both pairs are configured.

apiSecret.description: Outbound API secret (pair with **apiKey**; JSON camelCase, not `api_secret`).

username.description: Outbound login username (pair with **password**). Used when apiKey/apiSecret are not configured, or kept as fallback when both pairs are stored.

webhookKey.description: Required inbound webhook verification key; null or empty string is rejected.

authType.description: Optional hint; effective mode is derived. At least one credential pair required. Priority: apiKey+apiSecret, else username+password.

tokenUrl.description: Optional token/login endpoint override. When omitted, adapter uses apiEndpoint plus configured token path (e.g. wxzhonggeng `/sim-user-center/api/login`).

enabled.description: Integration runtime switch. `true` => ACTIVE; `false` => INACTIVE (CMP will not treat it as active integration).

config.description: Adapter-specific extension config JSON. Keep `{}` when no custom adapter parameter is required.

subscriptions.description: Optional; new integrations default to no enabled subscriptions.

apiKeyOnly.summary: apiKey + apiSecret（仅 API Key 认证）
apiKeyOnly.description:
JSON 字段名为 **apiKey** / **apiSecret**（camelCase，非 api_key / api_secret）。
出站运行时 effective **authType** = `api_key`。

usernamePasswordOnly.description:
JSON 字段名为 **username** / **password**（camelCase）。
未配置 apiKey/apiSecret 时，effective **authType** = `username_password`。

bothCredentialSets.summary: 两套凭证（apiKey 优先，username/password 备用）
bothCredentialSets.description:
可同时保存 **apiKey+apiSecret** 与 **username+password**。
运行时优先级：1) apiKey+apiSecret → `api_key`；2) 否则 username+password → `username_password`。

name.description: When provided, null or empty string is rejected.

adapterType.description: Same semantics as create request; currently `wxzhonggeng`.

apiEndpoint.description: When provided, null, empty, or invalid http/https URL is rejected.

apiKey.description: When provided with authType api_key; must not be set for username_password.

apiSecret.description: When provided with authType api_key; must not be set for username_password.

username.description: When provided with authType username_password; must not be set for api_key.

password.description: When provided with authType username_password; must not be set for api_key.

webhookKey.description: When provided, null or empty string is rejected.

authType.description: When changed, matching credential fields must be sent in the same request.

deprecatedBy.description: Operator identifier stored on the row. When omitted, defaults to JWT subject (userId/sub), e.g. platform admin M2M client id.

deprecationReason.description: Optional audit note explaining why the integration was deprecated.

period.description: Billing period (YYYY-MM). Must be a completed month before the current UTC month.

resellerId.description:
Optional RESELLER **`tenants.tenant_id`** (**FR-058**).
**Reseller admin JWT**: omit to use token `resellerId`; if set, must equal the token value.
**Platform admin / admin API key**: omit with `enterpriseId` omitted to bill all resellers' enterprises;
set alone to bill all child enterprises of that reseller; set with `enterpriseId` to bill one enterprise.

idempotencyKey.description:
Optional client idempotency key. Omit or null for no key. Explicit empty or whitespace-only string
returns **400 BAD_REQUEST**. Same non-empty key + same billing scope (`period`, `resellerId`, `enterpriseId`)
returns the existing **BILLING_GENERATE** job (**202** while queued/running, **200** when **SUCCEEDED**).
Reusing the key with a different scope returns **409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT**.

enterpriseId.description: Echo of scoped enterprise when single-enterprise job; null when platform all-enterprises or reseller batch-all.

resellerId.description: When set, RESELLER **`tenants.tenant_id`** for jobs enqueued under reseller admin JWT scope (**FR-058**).

paidAmount.description:
Amount received as recorded by the reseller (audit-only).
Must be >= 0; persisted to **`bills.paid_amount`**; not validated against bill **`total_amount`**.

paymentRef.description: Required payment reference (e.g. internal voucher id).

paymentProof.description:
